craft_notes: Sthāyin: cakrodaya unit 45. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 10. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: In garland-mantras in all mental recitation is said; or whispered śakti-rising of them not should arrange.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mālāmantreṣu sarveṣu mānaso japa ucyate upāṃśurvā śaktyudayaṃ teṣāṃ na parikalpayet
